title: Sociability depression

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Sociability depression is a cognitive effect in which a person has a decreased desire to interact or be around people. Sociability depression can come in many forms such as a temporary introversion effect, lack of desire to interact with others, and more isolation. This can be caused by anxieties or preexisting mental problems/distortions. 

Sociability depression is usually caused by sedating substances, or certain hallucinogens such as LSD. This is caused when the substance induces social anxiety, or the lack of need for interaction.

Sociability depression can also cause other effects with prolong exposure such as depression.

* Responsible Use
* LSD - Subjective Effects
